title: Bronco
extract:
The Bronco functions like a cross between a shotgun and handgun, that comes in a handy package to complement long range primary weapons.
This weapon can be sold for  5,000; it is also a weapon crafting ingredient for  Akbronco (x2).

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Can use the Bronco-exclusive  Dizzying Rounds mod.
Advantages over other Secondary  Shotgun Sidearm weapons (excluding modular weapons):

High overall status chance.
Innate multishot of 7 pellets.
Very ammo efficient.

Acquisition
The Bronco's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn Bronco Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Bronco with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Bronco Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Yao Shrub, and 100  Nacreous Pebble.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 40 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Bronco's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 0.5 rounds to a maximum of 20. Once all ammunition is expended, the Bronco reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
The weapon's spread cone can be shrunken by zooming in.
It is surprisingly effective at dealing damage over groups of enemies, in close to mid range fights.
Using maxed  Seeker is recommended to upgrade its crowd controlling capability, making it the best scatter-damaging sidearm.

Trivia
The word Bronco is a term in a Spanish Dialect meaning "rough".
It is also a common term for wild horse in Western culture.
Its appearance is similar to the Mauler shotgun-pistol from Halo.
